Morning briefing out — Criminal textbook only to pack, separate PACI blocks, home gap in between

Expanded the Charter note in the vault — section 10 in full, plus the criminal-law angles on 7, 8, 9, 11, 12 and 24(2)

Back to PACI for Indigenous Legal Traditions — all three readings done and filed last night
First tutoring session ever — came back with the good stuff: doctrine tables, canned answers and a concept cheatsheet for every outline
Benched the outline builds and drilled the skill-writing skill instead — it is now the model every other skill gets measured against

Chicken burgers on kaiser buns, as decided — oatmeal for breakfast, bread and butter at lunch, food journal closed
Constitutional Law outline built and spot-verified in its Google Doc tonight — all 17 course cases placed by doctrine, zero gaps
